newsitem.title: USA: Affiliated Computer seeks NYSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Affiliated Computer seeks NYSE listing.

text.p: Afiliated Computer Services Inc said Monday it has filed an application to trade its Class A common stock on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).
The information technology services and electronic funds transaction processing company's stock is currently traded on the Nasdaq under the symbol ACSA.O
Darwin Deason, chairman and chief executive, said the move will provide the company with greater visibility, liquidity and access to a much larger population of prospective investors.
